epigraph.en:
“Earth, who was it who measured and divided you with walls, wire, enclosures?”
- Pablo Neruda

“No Human is Illegal”
- Chants outside the Internment Center for Foreigners, Barcelona (Spain), 11. January 2014

The consul banged on the table and said;
“If you’ve got no passport you’re officially dead”:
But we are still alive, my dear, but we are still alive.
- Auden WH. 1962. “Refugee Blues.” In Collected Shorter Poems 1930- 1944, pp. 256-57.

“A specter haunts the world and it is the specter of migration. All the powers of the old world are allied in a merciless operation against it, but the movement is irresistible... The legal and documented movements are dwarfed by clandestine migrations: the borders of national sovereignty are sieves.
- Michael Hardt and Antonio Negri in Empire

facilitator_note.en:
As part of CILAS’s efforts to build social infrastructure for caring commons, this summer course attempts to open up the following possibilities:
- Participants from financially disadvantaged backgrounds are welcome to apply for course fee waiver and a subsidize for commute cost.
- CILAS will offer one “study day” each week for participants to use CILAS as a space to read, discuss and chill out.
- Tea and refreshments will be served during course meetings.
